name: GronlandsBANKEN A/S
summary: GrønlandsBANKEN A/S provides financial services to private customers, business customers, and public institutions in Greenland. The company offers deposits, loans, guarantees, and cards; and online and mobile banking, and professional advisory services. GrønlandsBANKEN A/S was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Nuuk, Greenland.
